Vision Zero manifesto · Barcelona

Fewer riders killed or injured. Act before the next crash.

A digital twin of Barcelona’s street network that combines Guàrdia Urbana crash records, Meteocat rainfall, sun position and rider near-miss reports. It diagnoses why riders get hurt at each intersection, simulates fixes and drafts the work order.

Technical room · restricted access

The intersection-level map, the engineering engine and the digital twin are shipped encrypted (AES-256-GCM). They are decrypted only in this browser with the evaluator password.

The Showcase uses district aggregates and a 500 m grid. The technical room works at intersection level (~11 m) with the full engineering engine.

Data: Guàrdia Urbana (Open Data BCN), Meteocat XEMA, Barcelona City Council neighbourhood boundaries. Projections are estimates to be validated in the pilot.

      Telemetry and anomaly detection

      Reports and hard-braking events are aggregated in ~225 m zones over 28 days. A zone is anomalous if P(X ≥ observed) < 1% (Poisson with Bonferroni correction), with ≥3 events on ≥2 days.

      Motorcycle crashes per km of street, 2015–2025. 82% of deaths happen outside black spots: this view shows risk spread along a street. Tap a street to see its route.

      A crash at an intersection counts for both streets. Length is that of the stretch with crashes. Without traffic counts, risk is measured in crashes, not per vehicle-km.
